party_a_statement: My business partner and I started a restaurant together in 2022 with equal investment of 500000 INR each. I handled all operations and day to day management for 3 years. He only provided money but never worked. Now he wants 50 percent of everything including the goodwill and customer base which I built entirely. This is unfair. I want 70 percent share based on my contribution.
party_b_statement: We are equal partners with equal investment as per our partnership deed signed in 2022. The deed clearly states 50-50 profit and asset sharing. My partner has been drawing a salary for his work which was already his compensation. The investment and business assets should be split equally as agreed. I want my 50 percent share which is approximately 800000 INR.
